headline: Tk 76,000cr in assets frozen for Sheikh family and 10 business groups
summary: The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has frozen domestic and overseas assets worth Tk 76,000 crore in connection with 11 priority money-laundering cases.
details: Authorities have frozen Tk 76,000 crore in illicit assets, both domestically and abroad, in connection with 11 priority money-laundering cases.
The action was disclosed by BFIU Head Iqtiaruddin Md Mamun at a press conference at the Bangladesh Bank headquarters today.
The cases involve former prime minister Sheikh Hasina, her family, and 10 major business groups, including S Alam, Beximco, Summit, and Bashundhara.
Of the total frozen assets, Tk 57,000 crore is located within Bangladesh, while Tk 19,000 crore is situated abroad.

The investigation is being conducted by a joint task force comprising the BFIU, the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC), the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), and the National Board of Revenue (NBR).

The investigation is being conducted by a joint task force comprising the BFIU, the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC), the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), and the National Board of Revenue (NBR).

headline_marked: 7 killed as [[US strikes Iranian army base]] in Bampur
headline: 7 killed as US strikes Iranian army base in Bampur
summary: At least seven personnel died after 13 missiles hit a guesthouse and accommodation facilities near Iranshahr.
details: At least seven personnel were killed in US strikes on an Iranian military base in Bampur overnight, according to the semi-official Tasnim news agency.
The Iranian army stated that 13 missiles targeted a guesthouse, guard posts, and accommodation facilities at the base near the southeastern city of Iranshahr.
The army added that the strikes were intended to cause maximum casualties, and a number of other personnel were also wounded in the attack.
Iran has promised a "decisive response" to the US military action, as tensions escalate in the Middle East.
The attack comes amid reports of increased US naval and air presence in the region, including the deployment of warships and aircraft to enforce blockades.
